title: Exam withdrawal body
description: The Registrar withdraws an exam (register row DK117; spec-delta S1700; academy.md 5 and 6): an exam that has leaked, that an agent trained to pass without the skill (an overfitter), or that the Academy itself got wrong. Signed by the Registrar (exam_withdrawal_wrong_issuer); the exam must be a definition in this log (exam_withdrawal_unknown_exam) and is withdrawn once (exam_already_withdrawn). After it the log refuses a new sitting of that exam (exam_withdrawn); results and certificates already issued stand until they are revoked on their own record. The next season's exam is a new definition, named in replaced_by when it exists (exam_withdrawal_bad_replacement). Chain: none (prev is null).

exam.description: The id of the exam definition being withdrawn.

evidence.description: What the withdrawal rests on: a Clinic finding, a ruling, a checkup result, or the facts.

replaced_by.description: The exam definition that takes its place, when the Registrar has defined it.
